text: Many if not all the main events races, Scotties Big Night are pay to win. It's a good game if played occasionally but don't get drawn in by the free dice as the game is designed to get you so close to winning that you only need to pay £5 or £10 to win but often more money is needed. The sticker albums are impossible to complete unless you pay for the wild cards as they lock cards that can't be traded. A single wild card £59.99.

Have been playing for years now and I've only completed an album once because a friend helped and then I paid for something only finished a partner event once as well but I was playing with three friends. such a rigged game with no chance of progression. deleted it once but thought I'd give it another go. waste of time unless your paying lots of money to play. I've paid a few times in the past but still no progression.

only way to progress and win prizes is to spend money. I loved this game to start with, then spend money on dice to progress in events and close albums. since the kitty event I have made 1 purchase. I need nearly 30 cards to finish the Album. never make it close to the top on events. become really frustrating. the only way to win is to spend.

not fun anymore. Ive been playing the game for 2.5 yrs. Only ever finished 3-4 albums in all that time. Don't have a lot of spare cash, who foes, but it feels the only way to progress is to spend. The last album Harry Potter was the hardest of all. There are trading groups on FB and I think a lot of people will be leaving this game from their comments. It's a shame as it was fun, but not anymore.

1 of the worst games I've ever played, you get bombarded with ad after ad after ad the moment you open up the app it takes 5 minutes to actually play the game as ur just trying to close ad after ad and the same thing happens when u run out of dice the game is such a scam and they think by squeezing as many ads as they can that they will make the most money in a short period of time its disgusting I hope they get sued...... In reply to your message the ads are your ads trying to sell dice

I started playing the game after seeing it advertised at the six nations rugby, I firstly gave the game a glowing review & became hooked on it. Sadly these last two albums like many others have not been enjoyable. For weeks now the highest cards for rewards are constantly 3 stars or below, if your lucky enough to get a 4* it's like getting a 5*or 6* & it seems as though your being pushed to spend money. For the last two weeks I've been on 400 dice & unable to trade as don't have anything

They've ruined game. The used to be enjoyable, you work your way up the level and ranks and get more rolls. Since the horrible Harry Potter theme they've cut the rolls meaning you can only earn so much and it cuts your game short and puts you at a disadvantage. Used to love playing this on my commute, pointless now, no fun at all. Also the stickers are a scam, you'll never complete the bigger sets with higher rewards. Shame on you Monopoly.

Few technical issues with events but overall very fun game, however, persistent updates has left my phone outdated and im now dealing with error after error upon booting the game up. Re-installed several times. Have been temporary banned for 3 days in the process and when i contacted customer support, they couldnt even detail the reasoning for the ban. I've been unable to play since, conveniently all started during the mid week update. Collected my community chest rewards and it went downhill.

Easy to play, addictive. Set the dice to auto-roll, and just watch the money come in. It's quite nice to leave on the phone when you're not using it, if you're someone who has to have something happening in the background. Unfortunately, it does have the 'If you want to do better quicker, PAY!' every free app now comes with. Hence the 4 out of 5 rating.

Up in high levels, and you need a lot of dice and money to level up. They put the dice up to 800, which was perfect for high-level because you could roll 50 dice if you wanted and actually build up some money, but they dropped it down to 400, which is just dreadful at this level and just don't enjoy the game as much now. On top of that, they keep doing the same old quests to win stickers you don't even need, they give you 2 or 3 days to win that but when it's something good, you get a day

I downloaded this game a year ago and I loved it. I played it multiple times a day. But now it's just not worth the effort anymore. As others have said in order to win shields and tokens or complete card sets you have to spend money... which I'm not interested in doing. Also annoyed that progress isn't consistent. For months I had 80/800 rolls... went down to 50/500 for no reason and for the past few days down again to 40/400... today I've uninstalled the game for good.

good game,Great Development,responsive Dev'S and customer support which is good if any issues, things I would like to see added in future? a build all option ,if enough to finish village,and also not to receive excess tokens as rewards after I have completed an event.and no longer any use for tokens and would be nice to have something other than cards to send to our good friends,ie gifts,also an "in-game chat system between friends" would really go well with this game 🎮🎯

I have to agree with all of the negative reviews here.. Not family friendly at all, it is a gambling game and the algorithms support that 100%. They use the same systems as casino's. It's very repetitive also. The same 4 or 5 games with the worst and most controlled by paying players as the most frequent. The events are only winnable if you have enough dice to roll really high all the time which is only possible if you pay 2 play. The support team are unhelpful and not honest about the game.

Unfortunately I have to agree with some of the more negative reviews regarding Monopoly Go. You will rarely (if ever) finish events or a sticker album without paying. Even when you do purchase items, you are not guaranteed to. Purchasing a pack with a sticker in, and not knowing what you will get is the definition of gambling. This needs investigating and regulating. By all means play for free and have some harmless fun, but under no circumstances should you purchase anything in this game!

The game used to be fun. The idea is to collect stickers to complete an album. Even playing the game as often as possible its impossible to complete the albums. Once you miss out on finishing 1 album every album after that is a waste of time. I've missed out on 3 albums in a row now by 1 sticker. I've been on every day every couple of hours. Played all of the events and partner events pushing to do as well as possible. The rewards are so out of reach now it's impossible to complete. Uninstalled

Been playing for nearly a year now. Game is getting worse. More bugs, people scamming each other and I've just come home from work to find I've been shut down 21 times by one player in 5 hours. Tried to contact customer support but found myself going in circles. What a epic waste of time. Save your time, don't bother to download if you want a free enjoyable game. This isn't it anymore!!

It's such a repetitive game. You do same thing over and over again. You roll dice, go around the board collect money and then build some buildings. Once all the buildings are built fully you go to the next board and repeat. Oh also the roll of the dice can be automated too. It's such a rinse and repeat. And don't get me started on the amounts of ads they push for you to buy their dice and cash. Horrible game. Don't know how on earth it has such a high rating.

Used to be a fun game. You were able to play the game with your own speed, progressing in the game as it suited you. I played this game for over a year. It started as a trading game. We used to trade stickers to progress in the game and finish sets and the album and try again for higher rewards. With this new season there is no need for trading, because you'll get all your tradeable stickers from the packs then Scopely "gold block" you so you can't finish the album. The game is no fun anymore!

I really enjoy the game itself, it is a lot of fun! The issue is... trading. I know people can gift stickers and that is amazing, but if you actually want to TRADE (as you are actually encouraging to do) it is so easy to find people scamming you and getting your stickers without sending you something in return. I think this mechanic would be nicer if changed so it is harder to scam/get scammed and disappointed.

Let's make this very clear. This is slot machine in disguise. Give it a month, maybe even less for some, and you'll be putting money in to get the chance of getting a reward or finish off your landmarks. These words come from experience, I've spend £150+ and for what? Some sticker packs to complete an album for more money to complete a never ending board. It'll be interesting to see the response from the devs but please turn your cards off while playing so you save your money!

The game itself is fun and being interactive with other players is great. However, the constant flood of ads is out of control. The bonus pack purchase ads appear as soon as you enter the game and is way too easy to accidentally click on. Unfortunately, I was one of those unlucky ones who got charged for the most expensive bonus packs, more than once! And Google does not see this as a problem and refuses refunds! Had to uninstall and give up this game! Players beware!!!

It's a play to win kind of game, but even if you do pay, you can't really get anything good. All the contests go by so fast, you can never really do anything with them. All the goals feel so out of reach, and dice regeneration doesn't help anything. I shouldnt have to wait 10 hours just to be able to have full dice (I have a cap of 60 rolls and am earning 6 per hour).

This game will do its damndest to make you buy dice. The current challenge i was previously #1 with the closest being a few hundred away from me. Suddenly some random player comes in with 4000 points, well over 2000 above mine when they previously weren't in the list. Not only that, but it took them less than 10 minutes to accomplish. Either a cheater, or a bot the game designed to make you buy dice to beat such players.

Loved this game to begin with, after some time though you soon realise that it's just another typical game that doesn't cater for people's financial status. If you wanna do well in this game then you're gonna have to spend some money. The events and challenges are ridiculous, because they give you a small time frame in which to complete the tasks and you never actually do it, you only ever get really close. How you gonna play with no dice? Oh I know just buy some! - well we can't all do that! 😔

I enjoyed this game for a year, but it became a daily obsession. There's no gambling addiction warning, so if anybody sees this that battles with spending money to get ahead/ will want to finish events.. I'd highly recommend not getting sucked into it. You literally see the game forcing spins to miss good slots and encourages you with game packs all the time, making it feel like spending £10 - £60 on a bunch of cards and dice in a game is reasonable. If your kids play.. beware! Had to delete it!

I like this game, but it's pretty clear what their motive is, your money. When you load the game up you have to go through 2 or 3 different "offers" trying to you purchase something before you've even begun to play. This is highly annoying and is slowly making me not want to play. There are plenty of ways to earn dice rolls that aren't paid for, but, like all mobile games, micro transactions are the quickest.

Sometimes you can build up your £, leave the game for a few hours, come back, to see your money is still there. Other times - since the last update - you can build up millions only to go back an hour later and most of it has gone! Where's the fun in that? Are we supposed to stay attached to it 24 hours a day? Not good. Then there are the challenges, impossible to finish unless you pay ALOT for extra credits. Why would you buy credits anyway, if someone can steal it all? Tiring of this. Not fun

REALLY dull. You just keep clicking until you run out of rolls but essentially it's just an idle clicker game. Click. Get some cash. Upgrade buildings that do nothing. When all upgraded move on to another level. Yawn. Occasionally try to break someone's buildings but 80% of the time they have a shield. Sometimes u click on boxes to match 3 items but just get some cash. No skill required. This is nothing like monopoly. Dodgey so many 5* reviews as looking at last 50 most r 1-3*. Suspicious.

The game is fun, but it's incredibly pay-to-win once you reach the late game stages. Unless you fork out for the in-game packs, you're pretty much constantly waiting to get your dice back, and you only get 80 dice, which is practically nothing for the higher level players. I get that the developers need to make their money, but the packs aren't even reasonably priced. Considering what you get in them, they're easily the most overpriced in-game purchases of any mobile game I've played.

It's an OK game with friends, and card trading is a nice addition. However, the mini competitions are very much geared to those who pay to win the game. Within the first hour, the top spot was taken by someone who had ammased over 50 thousand points, and the 2nd and 3rd were not far behind. This means the top slots and sometimes the top 20, where the best prizes are, are very much off limits to those who do not pay.

As others have said- the game is fixed not random. I have only found this out after moving up through the levels of the game. You you would think they would come up with a way to make levels harder without fixing the game. That's just frustrating and nothing to do with any type of skill. Oh and it's full of people that openly admit to cheating!

This game is highly addictive in negative way. I could put it in one category with game slots. It is nice game though, but the way it is made, it compares to game slots. And with enormous amount of in game purchase pop ups, it makes you want to buy extra dice because you are so close to reach the target. And these deals to buy a dice pops up whenever you open app, there are at least 3 pop ups, then- every time you run out of the dice, immediately pop ups appear to offer you buy more dice.

It's an alright game. But I realised that the more you progress and the more friends you have, the more broke you'll be. Every day, i load into Monopoly Go, expecting to continue my progress from earlier. However, I load on just to see that my 1.5M has gone down to 45K in just a day. This means to grind all over again, and it just keeps happening. It's really annoying.

So giving a 2 star becasue although I love the game, when people send you cards they don't ALL arrive. I need 1 card to complete a set and someone sent said card and oh look it has NOT arrived 26 hours later!! It keeps saying, "there's been a problem"!! I've contacted support and still waiting for them to get back to me. I don't think it will be long and I will be deleting the game!!!

The microtransactions (in-app payments) are a joke. They're so expensive and predatory. There is a cheat to get dice which loads of other players seem to be able to use, but it ruins the game for everyone else. You have very little chance of getting in the top 5 for most of the daily/2 day events. The stickers are ridiculous. You get the same ones continuously, even when opening high level packs. There are online groups where people try to SELL the stickers. Again. Ridiculous. Don't bother.

If you want to come first in a tournament, finish a partners event, complete a peg-e mini game , finish the dig game, or complete an album, then be prepared to spend your money. The first year, it wasn't like that. now it's almost impossible without spending your hard earned cash. Mini games come round quickly, so you'll never have enough dice for anything. The game has become boring and repetitive with no end result.

It's a straight up money grab. it was fun for a while, the graphics are good and it's addictive. But now it is 100% pay or get nowhere, many many events but you have no chance of getting anywhere in them unless you spend, and spend pretty big. It feels very greedy, and there is no RNG so you are at the mercy of the game, you'll always be just short of what you need, but guarantee a pop up will appear letting you buy the extra rolls or whatever you need. Had a lot of potential but just avoid.

Update review If the game doesn't come with a warning, it should. Its a good game and can be fun but there is a but.. I never thought I'd say something like this, but I've never been addicted to something before and with the prices being so high and silly I found myself spending stupid amounts just to complete tasks, it didn't help when the game had issues and then wouldn't load sometimes just kept getting "This is taking longer than usual" messages, etc I've spent £212.91 since June.

Didn't really understand the point.. you roll dice and hope that you land on a station? So that you can steal money from another player? There are literally zero decisions to be made, it's all up to chance and there's not even a gameplay loop that makes you want more rolls. It's not really a game at all when you think about it. I really wished they'd put more game design into an app that probably cost quite a bit to make...

Fun game BUT !!! Started out as a fun game but the amount of dice you get daily is low. The card packs are all duplicates, no matter how many you get. No matter how high you get you still get the same amount of dice as someone on level 1 for completing a board. No rewards when there's a glitch & you can't get in the game. Unless you are prepared to spend silly amounts of money, the game becomes tedious.

This is a good game if you have plenty of time and nothing else to do. However the tournaments should last longer, for those who work or have things to do to give them a chance to complete. I love the dig for treasure, but 3 days is too short and not enough opportunities to get pick axes. Also there should be a way to earn dice if you run out. Maybe a mini game of skill. That way you have a choice, buy extra dice or earn them. I feel buying dice Is way too expensive for what you get.

Game has been going downhill for over a year. Only way to progress, complete mini games and collect cards, is paying crazy money for in game dice/currency! Open the game, 5 pop ups for purchases. Use up all your dice, 5 more pop ups. Played for over a year and never once completed a mini game or cards, cos I don't buy overpriced dice/game currency. Once or twice I came close, and that was playing the game 3 or 4 times daily, but now, no chance! Soon to be uninstalled. It's no longer fun. 👎

I love anything monopoly rated ( don't ask lol) This is a great pass time in morning waiting for taxi to go out and then before bed. I ran in a couple problems why only 4*. I disagree with a comment I saw as you can play the game not buying anything, and if you don't play for a while, that's part of the game and why you need sheilds to protect you buildings and then when they ran out yes you building may get damaged and you pay to fix them, which is part of the game play.

This isn't even a game. Games involve skill. After 10 minutes and what you'll see is multiple pop ups for you to buy dice. This is a cash generator for the makers and nothing else. If they felt shame they'd be ashamed. A pointless series of random tasks, no skill in order that you run out of dice and feel the need to purchase more. This game format is so common, every one of them rubbish. An utterly pointless waste of everyone's time.

What a load of absolute rubbish, it's barely monopoly and you don't actually play the game, it's just another mobile cash farm and they just copied the same old formula onto the Monopoly brand to ruin there reputation for an easy paycheck. The game throws a lot of "money" at you for just pressing "roll" (which the "game" can even do for you), and slowly gives you less and less to do, in the hopes that you're bored and addicted enough to buy in-game items for real money. Its not a game.

All I can say is, what a waste of time. Rigged and full of glitches to make you lose. It's only fun for the start where they deliberately show you winning so that you get hooked on the game but as soon as your passed the first few rounds, this game is full of robots, glitches and rigged. The best thing I did was deleting this game after playing it for a year and I was on level 550(20,358). Wasted so much time for nothing.

The game designers are very greedy. To pass basic challenges in the game you probably need to spend £2-300 a month and if you hope to complete the stickers it's going to be more like £500. You may be rolling dice but there is no chance involved. The game is just steering you into spending money to advance. And even if you do spend money the game will always narrowly avoid completing the challenge in the hope that you'll pay more. Complete waste of time and obvious cash trap for the unwary.

As I'm a fan and collector of the Monopoly board game, the mobile version is also a fun game to play as well. The boards are cool to look at, and the animations are pretty cool, too! Some of the features that would be so cool to have are social interaction (moderator support,) with the people you add as friends, even emojis to the other players on your board when you steal money from them, or receiving rent from them. I personally can't stop playing this game everyday. Recommended 5*

Underhand 😞, took money for a pack I didn't buy. Like a few reviews say; you get bombarded at log in, to pay for something. I've always managed to cancel, say no. One in particular; you swipe through to say no, it can go to the 1st stage of purchase, I always catch it. Days ago, logged on to the usual swipe to say no to offers, purchases & before I know it I'm being charged £99 for something I didn't 'buy' or authenticate. Monopoly Go, kindly respond to my messages ** Still no reply to my msgs

We love playing and all the levels are really fun. I would change how you can connect with children who can only play via a tablet. My Niece is playing and we still can't connect and I only joined in the first place to be able to play with her. So this needs changing, you should be able to type their name in so you can add them. It's great for all ages.

I've been playing the game for more than 1 year was fun and rewarding at the beginning and now is ridiculous and frustrating. This game focuses on how to force players to spend money on the game in order to complete an album. When you take this issue with customer service you receive the same excuse "I know how frustrating it is as I am in the same situation, and i'm sure you will complete your album" ... bla blah... I've seen the same reply to multiple players on FB and nothing happens.

Was a fun game to play once. Introduced many friends to it and now wish I hadn't. The higher level you get the worse off you are. Rewards become virtually non existent or not worth the effort. Not once come even close to completing albums unless willing to pay for things. Definitely become just a pay to play game. Shame as started out so good.

Was a great experience at the beginning, however, now I've come to realize it's a snare. They give you everything at the start and get you hooked then to lower your chances of winning again. The measley dice you receive it has turned into a pay to play game. People were using methods to get more dice because the dice packs they sell are at an extortionate price so they decided to do a forced update to stop that. You have card scammers too, there needs to be a better way to trade these cards.

This game is good but I have more complaints than things that are good about the game. First, the game is the most biased game I have played. It miscalculates the dice so you never land on what you're supposed to. Also I raided my brother, he lost no money. He raided me two minutes later but I lose all my money? Biased! Second, the boards take too long to complete as you only get rewards every 500 levels and no dice. Third, cards are also biased. I don't ever get new cards for like thirty days!

Used to love this game, I have spent a lot of money TRYING to complete albums.. The new changes are impossible for you to complete , with 1 sticker in the green pack etc.. the daily tournament originally had 20 players per team, and now it is 50 players per team. The chance of winning is poor.. The more boards you complete, the less chance you have of completing any album .. The focus of this game is to get as much money out of you with less achievements to complete set tasks. SHAME ON YOU

Tasks are now impossible. They set up events that don't work and even when you supply proof via screenshot, its denied that there's an issue. Trading is impossible, gold card trades are pointless as everyone is missing the same cards. Its fun for a while, but then a lot of waiting around for dice unless you spend ££££. Customer support don't want to know. I tried....ETA there's no point responding to this saying you take feedback into account, you don't. I sent screenshots of faults. No joy.

The game is good at 1st but soon gets boring when you have to wait 10 hours to get full dice that last 2 minutes. Also getting a load of the same stickers. Iike why can't we trade gold stickers? But we get duplicates of them! You just don't get enough dice to play unless you spend money and that's clearly what they want you to do. Think also finishing a level and only getting 50 dice is ridiculous when it's the same no matter what level your at. Sort this out cause people are just going to leave

So If I don't add friends, I don't have the community chest etc? They're the best places on the board! I don't want to play and have the responsibility of daily tasks etc, thst I'm sure follows the friend additions. I don't KNOW 5 people who have the time to play games. And if they do, they're pc or console gamers like me. I can't play those. And the whole concept is nothing like the game. Also, 5 dice an hour? The only option is to purchase dice. Not even watching an ad to earn extra rolls.

I enjoy the game when I am not being harrassed. There is a glitch. I am constantly being attacked by someone not on my friends list, so you can not block them. I have emailed and I have messaged customer support through the app, yet no one has given a decent response. When someone is attacking you that much you can not progress or enjoy the game. It's weird, it is almost like they are trying to bully you. The devs don't care because you need to spend money to build your properties back...

The balance between free and paid features is way off. The game depends on being able to roll the dice to get cash rewards to upgrade your properties but with just 5 free rolls per hour, gameplay stalls pretty quickly and it's evident that to play in any meaningful way it's going to cost ££££ daily. Shame, because it looks great and is fun and entertaining but not something I will play going forwards.

This game was fun to begin with. Trading with friends, new friends joining and getting rolls and working together. Then I completed all the easy card sets, and new people stopped joining. Then, the game became super stale. Luck seemed to be in the gutter. The game doesn't give you enough dice to keep playing. Once you have reached a certain point, rolling on 1x, 2x, and 3x doesn't seem worth it anymore. So waiting an hour a time to receive 6 dice isn't enough. The game is a whale farm.

Addictive game, great graphics, many timed trials and challenges; but none designed to allow you to maintain and increase the number of dice you have. I've had 6000 dice, then all gone to zero. The algorithm ensures you can't hit specific board places to complete challenges, so you burn more dice than the challenge is worth, e.g. burn 1000 to get 250. Buying dice with cash is stupidly expensive. There is a pressure to complete tasks which can only be done by playing for hours & spending cash.

Is great to start with, it's an impossible game to complete card collections with spending decent amount of money, even with a few friends to trade cards with. Had 30 rolls today to only land on train stations twice. You land on whatever you don't need. As soon as the 2-3 day event is over then you will land on what you needed before regularly. Maybe I'm unlucky or maybe the code changes. I'm am still playing this game after 6 months.

Probably one of the smoothest, most entertaining and graphically pleasing Coin Master type game I've played. You get a good hour or so (depending on your luck) playing per day and the gameplay is usually quite rewarding. Just like all of these types of games, they lack a lengthy playtime due to their nature of having to wait for more dices or spins etc. Perhaps adding extra minigames that benefit your progress as a player would allow the game to earn more play time and satisfy addicted players.

If it was possible to not give any stars, I wouldn't. After numerous technical issues not being able to get into the game for hours to complete the baking challenge, then baking parnters points not registering, it became impossible to complete. Without these issues, I would have been able to completed all 4 cakes. Anytime you contact customer service via the game, they tell you 5 days to respond, and you never get a response.

It used to be lots of fun and you could easily play for free, but it's changed recently. The rewards in the mini side games are rubbish, and there's no way you could complete any of them without spending any money. Also noticed there's a lot less shields on the board now, so more difficult to protect your landmarks and they are getting shutdown a lot more than they used to.

Game was really fun to begin with, but it's now got boring, new cards just don't come, and no one wants to trade on the trade pages unless you're willing to donate an organ for the rare cards, resulting in not being able to complete sets to get dice to play, 8 dice an hour just isn't good enough to progress unfortunately in the higher levels. Shame really, I enjoyed playing but it got frustrating at first, now it's got me bored and not wanting to play.

I got really far into the game,well over level 65,told me I had to update, so did, still wouldn't work, trouble shooting said to uninstall then reinstall now iv lost everything, not worth playing if this is going to happen to your customers now is it really ,also was 19sticker's off of wildlife tales but now have to start all over again, the was good at first but now it's not worth my time, shame really cuz it was decent, don't spend any money on this app, you'll be better off using it on bills

I think you're really predatory with your pricing. £69.99 for 2,600 rolls? If someone chooses to roll at 50, that's 52 rolls. But they would probably choose more. So let's say 100 each time would be 26 rolls. Do you know how quickly 26 rolls would be made?! Less than 5 mins For £70!! Please stop. This is on par with gambling and you're setting a bad example. Do better! I understand you have your 'whales' you love to get money from but please stop.

Since the new update, I can not obtain anything that I need. I have not been able to get the purple pack from the community chest as often. It is maybe once in 3 months, when I could get it a couple times in a week. The purple packs no longer give you new stickers either. Without trading other players, it is more difficult to complete the albums. Customer service is no help during any of these problems. They award certain people but not everyone. The game used to be fun but now a waste of time.

I finally had enough of this game, after playing for 3 years I uninstalled it for good. It's beyond frustrating playing a game that has no rewards whatsoever. Being a part of the tycoon club doesn't actually matter if all you land on is the lowest money spot, playing the Peggy event doesn't matter at all if the game instant drops and gives you the lowest amount. All this game is, is a cheap money grab and if you don't spend money you don't get rewarded.

Okay so I loved the game at first it was fun ! but after playing a while, I feel as if 5 sends of stickers a day is way too little and it needs to be upped to either 10-15 . also getting stickers is so hard you can't even build your album . and you only get 8 dice an hour . if I was you I wouldn't download it unless you want to just have a game that you can't play because you are waiting on dice to reload !

The game is fun when you actually get to play. You barely get dice. For the events , you will either land right before or right after the spots you need to earn rewards. The whole game is based on luring you in to spend your money. They don't offer reasonably priced packs. I'm currently looking for a game you actually can play. Don't waste your time even giving this a shot unless you like to spend a fortune to play.

Was enjoying the game, though the ads were a smidge annoying. Then today, the game just wouldn't start, and it kept getting stuck at 30%. Couldnt get game to start, updated game, restarted phone, finally had to uninstall the game, then reinstalled gamecstarted first try and I discovered I'd lost all progress, everything, over 750 rolls, over 200m in cash, and a level 22 board. I'm not prepared to try and recover all that again... so sadly, I've uninstalled and won't be returning.

Game is awfully designed. The main reason myself and my friends play this is to complete the sticker albums. There are too many duplicates given in game which makes it difficult to get the whole set unless you spend a ton of money! The trade system is useless! The game recommends that you join the FB trading page in order to organise your own trades and there is no failsafe provided in the game. Its full of scammers they receive stickers then block you! Don't bother. It used to be quite an enjoyable game and you could play it *your* way. I used to buy special in-app purchases occasionally. Not able to progress in the game unless you spend money. I've only played for one day and come to a stand still. The rate at which the dice replenishes is ridiculous, you have to wait an hour to get 5 spins, 10 hours to fully replenish, by the time your dice are back all the money you had saved is gone and your buildings have been attacked. Beginning to lose interest. The game is fun when you have a lot of dice, but when you're on 8 an hour and buildings cost 50k to upgrade it becomes too difficult to progress because the money is stolen before you have enough. I've not had a single new sticker in weeks and keep getting ones I can't do anything with. The community chest is also not random.

This is barely a game. You click the same button for money until out of dice, then buy fancier landmarks. There are 2 fun-free minigames, the odd boring event + a stamp collection. The only strategy is in choosing the number of dice to spend on a click; otherwise it's just an endless loop of increasing prices with increasing rewards. It gets repetitive fast. It teases you with big rewards only really accessible if you pay money. It is aggressive about wanting your money. Spare yourself- avoid!

Game started well, enjoyable but so many things going on and impossible tasks to complete. Trying to collect cards for sets becomes tedious as you never get the cards you need even after massive amounts of go's and trading is pathetic no one trades and if they do they want something you want for exchange. The amount of pop ups to buy gets frustrating and even they are over priced. You can tell the creators have tweaked it to do the same ole thing to push people to buy, but it's not worth it.

I love the game. However, only let's me play so far, then says I have a bug. This is a 2nd device so I know how to play. Cannot report to customer services cause won't let me on the game. This game used to be much better, but this has turned into a complete money grab. The cost to upgrade buildings is stupidly high. Shame the developer has sold out and decided money is worth worth than user's.

It started out okay. However, within a couple of weeks, there are so many adverts and incentives to spend money pushed in your face. I got through the first three cities before deleting. Its VERY on rails. Even the showdown event (landing on railroads) is pointless. Doesnt matter what one you choose, you always win the same amount. The Heist game is rigged 100%. No variation in game play. It is fun for a while until you run out of rolls.... then either pay or wait a long time to re-fill. Two bonus' are that there are no adverts at all and graphics are nice.

Used to enjoy it I used to love this game - really enjoyable and levels were fair. Why turn a good game into something people are now getting bored of?! It's become popular, so I presume that's why. More people means the levels get harder, which means some people will actually pay. Only pro is there isn't any advertisements.

Only been playing a few days and already the novelty has wore off, load the game, play for 30 seconds then wait hours for your energy to refill?? Not worth the bother. It is a really fun game! If you enjoy collection style games & miss playing monopoly then it's definitely for you, well created. The game is fun, but it definitely favours the players who are willing to open their wallets. Here's 3 to 6 popups begging for microtransactions. Oh you're out of rolls? Here's 3 to 6 pop ups begging you to pay for more. 3 stars if you're playing without spending money for sure.

Time killer, based around many many other tried and tested mobile games, the same formula and gameplay, it will feel familiar but works well within the monopoly franchise. All the bits you can buy are on the screen anyway, we don't need to have to close down 5 or 6 ads before we can actually start playing. This game is fun, but quickly gets boring and monotonous, your constantly hounded by in-game ads upwards of 8 as soon as the game loads in, once your rolls are gone your hit with another 2 more begging to buy packs. Sticker packs are few and far between which makes collecting them quickly become boring as your constantly getting the same cards. it's a fun way to pass time until your around the 3500xp mark, then it's a money grab to get anywhere.

It's a beautiful game, smooth gameplay nice graphics, pop up adverts after running out of dice rolls to buy more extras is annoying, but minor annoyance, just a click to close. My previous review was disappointed with the lack of dice rolls after a short while, but now I'm more into the game I'm able to gather more dice rolls through prizes, otherwise it's waiting an hour for just 5 dice rolls, which I feel could have been a bit more generous. Rating to 4 stars now after further progression.
